scope: Nine new native512 CPU-FP32 model calls: V114/V115 on three previously fixed Q2/Sony/GFX50R contexts, plus the stronger released pre-upsampled RawNIND on the same exact physical inputs. Original V104 and half-RawNIND floats are reused. Two fixed native160 ROIs per capture; common input-only conditioning,WB,matrix,exposure. Hot-pixel repair off; single view; no clean reference, GT, pixelwise quality score, broad superiority or timing claim. No new RAW/source-HDD read, noise, training admission, optimizer update or CUDA. Frozen CPU2/nice10 job; failures retain completed predictions and stop without automatic retry.

visual_observations.q2: V114 Tiny,V115 Small and V104 remain close. All suppress fine grain, while dark rock structure stays soft. No clear overall improvement in these two fixed crops.
visual_observations.a7rii: V114/V115 remain close to V104. Fuselage grain is suppressed and window/joint edges remain soft, including softness already visible in the input. No clear overall version gain.
visual_observations.gfx50r: V114/V115 and V104 retain finer-looking concrete surface variation and thinner/more coherent joints than both RawNIND variants, which look coarser and more mottled here. Tiny/Small differences are small; absent a clean reference, every surface fluctuation cannot be identified as true detail.
visual_observations.overall: No large new qualitative gain over V104 is established on these six low-ISO development ROIs. This adds current models and the stronger released reference to the gallery; it does not establish broad real-camera superiority or change the general baseline.
